author: Inside Edition
description: Former Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem is said to be stunned by a published report that claims her husband may be leading a cross-dressing double life. In a statement, her representative said "Ms. Noem is devastated." The story about Bryon Noem was broken by the "Daily Mail," which published images appearing to show him wearing hot pink pants and a skin–tight shirt stuffed with large balloons for breasts. The Noems have been married for 34 years. Inside Edition reached out to Bryon Noem for comment but did not hear back.
title: Kristi Noem 'Devastated' After Report That Husband Is Cross-Dressing

author: Inside Edition
description: The affidavit has just been released for Tiger Woods latest arrest and it says Woods told police that he looked down at his cell phone and was changing the radio station before he hit a pickup truck and his Land Rover flipped over. The document says that during a search, a deputy "located two white pills" in Woods' pants pocket. The pill, through its identifying marks, was revealed to be hydrocodone, also known as vicodin, a potent prescription painkiller.
title: Tiger Woods Had Painkillers In His Pants After Crash: Affidavit

author: Inside Edition
description: Vanessa Hudgens shared a postpartum side effect of hair loss on social media. She shared a photo with strands of hair in her hand. The "High School Musical" star welcomed her second child in November. Meanwhile, Taylor Swift's latest single is paying homage to the ultimate showgirl, Elizabeth Taylor. And President Donald Trump announced plans for his presidential library in Miami. The massive waterfront skyscraper will have a red, white and blue spire at the top.
title: Vanessa Hudgens Shares Her Postpartum Side Effect On Social Media

author: Inside Edition
description: In a brazen case of road rage, a man got out of his car and started screaming and kicking another vehicle. Pol' Atteu and Patrik Simpson, reality TV stars from the Amazon Prime show "Grown and Out in Beverly Hills," along with their pet pooch Snow White, were in the car. The angry driver returned to his SUV and screamed at the celebrity couple before taking off. Atteu and Simpson say they did nothing to provoke the driver.
title: Reality TV Stars Say They Were Attacked In Road Rage Incident

author: Inside Edition
description: This chocolate egg is anything but Mini. Cadbury World in the U.K. decided to supersize a chocolate egg this Easter for fun. Their Mega Mini Egg weighs 120 pounds and is three feet tall. They say visitors to their factory also had a hand in making it. Chocolate prices are reportedly on the rise because of climate change, so conserving every last drop is important in these times. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cadbury Makes 'Mega Mini' Easter Egg That Weights 120 Pounds

description: You can find Amy Schulz easily, as she's hard to miss, working at the Dollar Tree in Rib Mountain, Wisconsin. She tells WSAW she dresses to impress because she hasn't done her job if you don't leave her store just a little happier. Manager Cheryl Butterfield says she enjoys putting on some decorations at work, but since she's busy traveling around to other store locations, she knows Amy is still pleasing customers at this store. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Enthusiastic Employee At Dollar Tree Dresses Up In Crazy Costumes
